# Lorem Ipsum

Generate Lorem Ipsum words, sentences or paragraphs.

Category: Generators · ID: `lorem` · Search terms: placeholder, dummy, filler, text

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui lorem [flags]
```

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--unit` | `paragraphs`, `sentences`, `words` | `paragraphs` | Unit. |
| `--count` | 1–100 | `3` | Count. |
| `--classic` | on/off | `true` | Start with “Lorem ipsum”. |
